frameworks.title: Particles do the heavy lifting
frameworks.body: 은/는 mark topic, 이/가 mark subject, 을/를 mark object. Word order is flexible because particles tell you who's doing what.

frameworks.title: Word order: SOV
frameworks.body: Korean ends sentences with the verb. '나는 밥을 먹어요' = 'I rice eat'.

frameworks.title: Politeness levels
frameworks.body: 안녕 (casual), 안녕하세요 (polite), 안녕하십니까 (formal). Match the right level to who you're talking to or sound rude/weird.

vocab.note: Korean picks the sibling word by who is SPEAKING, not only by who is being spoken about. A man says 형 for the same brother.
